# Character voice sources (generated by tools/audio/character_voices.py, do not edit)

Every file is a non-verbal vocal sound made from CC0 recordings (no speech, no AI audio). Sources: OpenGameArt packs (CC0 option), Freesound HQ previews of CC0 sounds, an itch.io CC0 pack, and the game's own CC0 sounds in assets/audio/sfx. Processing: rubberband pitch / tempo, EQ, echo, layering, -18 LUFS.
